title: WeMacro Bluetooth unexpected disconnect prevents reconnection
summary: Unexpected didDisconnectPeripheral marks the public connection disconnected without resetting device_count. After a successful connection count remains 1; the next connect increments it to 2 and skips the only delegate connect call guarded by count++ == 0. Reset/remove the single-device refcount coherently and test connected→unexpected-loss→reconnect callbacks. Source-contract evidence; no Bluetooth hardware executed.
